derivation: Create frozen 0001 plus ledger.sql in an owned temporary schema inside a rolled-back transaction; run catalog.sql with the exact target-only search_path. Capture structured definitions without OIDs, physical column ordering, sequence current values, owners, or pg_dump formatting. Builtin expression deparsing uses PostgreSQL 17 catalogs. Compare all required definitions; strict unledgered adoption also rejects extra application columns/constraints/indexes. Ignore unrelated relations.
capture_tool: driver scratch capture-catalog.py (local Docker psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1; rolled back schema)
immutability: v1 query, manifest, ledger DDL and checksums are frozen. Add an independently reviewed recognizer to support another released footprint; never regenerate v1 from evolving models.
